templates: They say {district} opens a different door after dusk.
A courier swears the tower moved one floor overnight.
A clerk left a note where the church would not look.
Someone counted the bells and found one missing.
The market price is wrong when the fog is thick.
The old route is watched; use the side stair.
A shrine answers only before the boss wakes.
A witness remembers the wrong name on purpose.
The newspaper cut the most useful line.
A sailor traded a tower floor for a cup of wine.
An apprentice marked the safe lever with soot.
The noble salon repeats passwords in pairs.
The mountain tea cools when a true lead is spoken.
A sermon hid a map reference in its third verse.
The alley storyteller knows which rumor is bait.
The last floor listens for a weakness tag.
